Patient: Pavel Galloway | DOB: 11/20/1958 | MRN: SYN-7627234
Date of service: 06/16/2025 | Dr. Kaveh Ellery, MD (Rheumatology)

History:
66-year-old man with rheumatoid arthritis diagnosed in 2022, seen to discuss escalation of therapy. Past medical history: hypothyroidism, gastroesophageal reflux.

Exam:
Synovitis of the MCP and PIP joints of both hands; no rheumatoid nodules.

Treatment history:
No prior conventional DMARD therapy; patient prefers to start a biologic.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: seropositive rheumatoid arthritis, DAS28-CRP 4.1 (moderate disease activity).
Pre-biologic screening: tuberculosis and hepatitis B screens negative.
Plan: start fictimab 40 mg subcutaneously every 14 days.
